title: Block Entity Component
description: Adds per-instance metadata for this block.

container.description: Adds a container to this block.

slot_count.description: Sets the number of slots in the container.

title.description: Optional container title, stored as a language file key or raw text. Must be nonempty and at most 256 characters.

dynamic_properties.description: Dynamic-properties can store and retrieve variables on a block via scripting, more at https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/minecraft/creator/scriptapi/minecraft/server/blockdynamicpropertiescomponent.

entity_storage.description: Stores serialized entities in this block via scripting.
